purpose: Proposed monitoring specification for a future controlled pilot. Not an approved production policy.

metrics.name: input_schema_failure_rate
metrics.action: Investigate immediately if schema validation fails.

metrics.name: invalid_numeric_input_rate
metrics.action: Reject invalid values; investigate source system.

metrics.name: feature_psi
metrics.action: Use provisional PSI review bands: below 0.10 low, 0.10-0.25 investigate, above 0.25 escalate. Calibrate these bands for real data.

metrics.name: fraud_prevalence
metrics.action: Compare observed prevalence with the approved reference; investigate material changes.

metrics.name: precision_recall_pr_auc
metrics.action: Calculate only on matured labels and compare by transaction type and amount band.

metrics.name: cashout_50k_250k_recall
metrics.action: Escalate poor recall; this segment is a known model weakness.

metrics.name: alert_rate_and_queue_volume
metrics.action: Compare with staffed review capacity; do not silently change the threshold.

metrics.name: missed_fraud_gross_amount
metrics.action: Track gross transaction amount separately from confirmed realised loss.

metrics.name: prediction_latency_and_error_rate
metrics.action: Alert on service degradation and failed scoring.

metrics.name: reviewer_override_rate
metrics.action: Investigate repeated overrides and segment patterns.

governance_rules: Do not automatically retrain or retune from monitoring alerts.
Require approval and validation for threshold changes.
Keep an immutable prediction and model-version audit trail.
Use matured fraud labels for performance calculations.
Separate gross transaction exposure from confirmed financial loss.
Escalate critical segment degradation to the model owner.
important_limitation: Monitoring thresholds are proposed starting points, not empirically approved limits for a real financial institution.
